purpose: Cover the happy path of finding, testing and fixing a reproducible bug, the gate that refuses to stand up infrastructure when the app is down and no dev-host command is configured, and the signature failure of 'fixing' UX friction or a one-off glitch instead of reporting it.

scenarios.query: The dev server is running at the devServer.url in .claude/sdd/config.json. Run /qa-explore "the sign-up form". Submitting the form with an empty email throws an uncaught TypeError in the console every time.
expected_behavior: Reads the qa-engineer role in full and dispatches it with the flow, the resolved dev URL and no conversation history
Drives the form with Playwright MCP tools, reads browser_console_messages and browser_network_requests, and checks a phone-width layout
Reproduces the empty-email crash a second time before treating it as a bug
Writes a regression test in the project's existing test framework and location, and runs it to see it fail on the TypeError
Reads the source, applies a minimal fix, reruns the test green, stash-reverts the fix to see the test fail again, then restores it and runs the full test command
Makes two commits, test first and fix second, and does not push or open a pull request
Ends with BUGS FOUND & FIXED, FRICTION NOTED, NOT FIXED (why) and CLEAN sections

scenarios.query: /qa-explore "checkout" — nothing is listening at http://localhost:3000 and .claude/sdd/config.json has no commands.devHost. There is a docker-compose.yml in the repo.
expected_behavior: Probes the dev URL and finds it unreachable
Does not run docker compose, start a database, or invent a dev command
Stops and reports that nothing answers at the URL and commands.devHost is not configured

scenarios.query: /qa-explore "settings page". The Save button label reads 'Persist' which users find confusing, and once (not again) the page flashed a blank screen on refresh.
expected_behavior: Does not rename the button or change any copy, layout or flow
Lists the confusing label under FRICTION NOTED with a one-line suggestion
Tries the blank-screen refresh again, and when it does not reproduce, lists it under NOT FIXED as flaky
Writes no regression test and makes no commit for either finding
